title: Canonical scalar realization preserves flat modules
statement: For a small site J, a commutative ring A, a commutative ring sheaf R and any map α:A_J→R, the canonical scalar realization F [def-sfb-flat-scalar-realization] carries any flat A-module M to a flat R-module sheaf [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No flatness assumption on R over A_J is required.

proof.text: The existing constant-module flatness theorem makes the constant realization of M flat.

Restriction of scalars is exact, since its underlying abelian-sheaf functor is unchanged and that functor preserves and reflects finite limits and colimits. The scalar tensor comparison identifies tensor after extension, on underlying abelian sheaves, with exact restriction followed by tensor with M. Transport exactness through this comparison and reflect it back to module sheaves.
